0.comment: Indarias: The Karmic Debt of the Yakshas
0.content: The yakshas had to cleanse the lingering hatred of fallen gods, and every battle left a tally of karmic debt on their souls. Some were consumed by rage, others by fear-driven madness; many turned on one another. Of the Five Foremost Yakshas, Indarias, Bonanus and Menogias are dead, Bosacius went mad and died fighting at the Chasm, and only Alatus (Xiao) remains. Indarias's end is described in the book only as part of this collapse.

1.content: In the 2.7 Chasm quest At Tunnel's End, Light, the Fantastic Compass preserves Bosacius's dying mind. His clearing memories show the five yakshas walking together, Indarias screaming under her karmic debt, and the other comrades' fates. Just before he dies he recognizes his comrades, and Indarias, Bonanus, Menogias and Alatus appear around him and call him brother. Xiao says afterward that he can finally put the matter to rest.
